messages.subject: Option grouping in selectInput (selectizeInput)
parts:
It is really cool that selectInput (selectizeInput) allows options to be grouped. When there is only one option in a group, it is not grouped.
 
Below is an example of the generated HTML:

 <select id="site" class="form-control">
<option value="270 - Azuza, CA; Bruce Largent">Azusa.CA</option>
<option value="440 - Calabasas">Calabasas.CA</option>
<option value="51 -  Carlsbad - Home">Carlsbad.CA</option>
<optgroup label="Milpitas.CA">
<option value="110 - Milpitas California">110 - MEI-Milpitas California</option>
<option value="962 - Milpitas - Design Center">962 - MTI - Milpitas - Design Center</option>
<option value="963 - Milpitas - Office">963 - CPG - Milpitas - Office</option>
</optgroup>

The top 3 items only have 1 option per group. Notice there is no <optgroup> tag.

My question is: Is it possible to have the text of the options without a group be the value content rather than the group content?

-Joe-
